name: Nightmare Girl
source:
You're a young woman living alone in Tokyo. On your way home from work one night, you're attacked by a pair of monsters; horrifying creatures like nothing you've seen before.

Fortunately, you're saved by a mysterious man. He reveals himself to be a Nightmare hunter, part of a secret organisation taking down these terrifying things. You think that's the end of it. But it's only the beginning...

[From [url=https://ghost-heart.itch.io/nightmare-girl]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是一位独自生活在东京的年轻女子。一天晚上，在你下班回家的路上，你遭到了一对怪物的袭击；你以前从未见过的可怕生物。

幸运的是，你被一个神秘人救了。他透露自己是一名噩梦猎人，是一个秘密组织的成员，该组织致力于消灭这些可怕的事物。你认为事情就这样结束了。但这只是开始……

[来自[url=https://ghost-heart.itch.io/nightmare-girl]Itch.io[/url]]
